pyramiding_rule: Forbid position layering unless floating trade profit exceeds 1.5x ATR and original SL is locked in profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require minimum 15-minute ATR volatility filter and volume spike confirmation; auto-reject entries between 20:00-21:50 UTC.
profit_harvest_threshold: Harvest 30% position at $5.00 float, auto-trail remaining volume with dynamic ATR sentinel to target $15.00-$30.00 scale-outs.
